summary:
R4 is the model to lean on right now — 61% at 48-31 (+19.0u) over the last 14 days and 62% season-long (+32.0u), the best strong-play conversion of any rating on the board. It's also carrying the hottest single cell today: bullpen at 58% over 14d (109-80), well above its own season pace. All four ratings share the bullpen_fatigue cold streak (41% last 14, 4L, -5.0pts under baseline) — treat any pick leaning on that category as a fade signal across the board today, not just background noise.

Today's board gives four rock-solid consensus plays where all four ratings stack with real separation: KCR @ BOS (BOS, deltas +1.45 to +1.81), LAD @ MIA (LAD, all negative -1.00 to -1.76 signaling road value), CLE @ MIN (CLE, -0.68 to -1.17), and CIN @ MIL (MIL, +0.60 to +1.56, R4 leading the pack at +1.56). BOS is the headline team-trend play too — 74% when picked season-long (39-14) and 79% in strong-play spots (+20.0u), so a full four-rating consensus with Sonny Gray on the mound is about as clean as this model gets. MIL similarly rates as a proven liked-team (63%, +10.0u strong), and with R4's bullpen strength showing up in a game where Milwaukee's pen matters late, that's a spot where the hot category and hot team intersect. PHI @ ATL and COL @ DET round out the tightly-grouped consensus tier (ATL +0.82 to +1.03, DET +0.66 to +1.23) but lack the standout team-trend or category backing.

The split games are where separation matters: LAA @ WSN and HOU @ TBR show R2 breaking off from the pack, and with R2's runs category running cold this window (47% at 89-100 over 14d), don't chase those R2 outliers against three-rating consensus. PIT @ CHC and CHW @ STL are near-pickem with deltas under 0.30 across every rating — thin signal, low conviction, best left alone today.
